entities.name: Kotō Bunjirō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bunjirō Kotō was a Japanese earth scientist (Geologist). He is from Iwami Province. Kotō is from Tokyo Imperial University, and after graduating, he became a professor at Tokyo Imperial University. He is known for taking photographs of the Neodani Fault when he investigated the 1891 Mino–Owari earthquake.
